subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.-----PHY.U.P.
description: Chart on book p. 383 (R(AS)CM(II)-27). POL-CON (political consciousness) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-F (information focus) and INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). From INFO-F: DOC (documentation). From INDIV-DY-RT: PART (participation), PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics) and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From PROJ-DYM: RE-ST (restructuralism).
